nodes.label: FactLens Backend Fact-check API
nodes.rationale: FastAPI plus LangGraph API at 127.0.0.1 colon 8010 classifying claims and grounding citations in fetched source texts

nodes.label: Backend Environment Keys Configuration
nodes.rationale: Keys in backend .env only: GEMINI_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY required one of, optional SERPAPI_API_KEY and YOUTUBE_API_KEY; auto order Gemini 3.8 Flash to Gemini 3.7 Flash to GPT-6 Luna

nodes.label: Search Verification Flow Max 3 Claims 6 Sources
nodes.rationale: Extract max 3 claims and queries, check SerpApi free quota, read max 6 sources, verify citations against sourceTexts, YouTube comments context only

nodes.label: Fact-check Streaming Endpoint
nodes.rationale: POST api fact-check stream returns NDJSON progress and final result used by frontend; consent must be true, text 1 to 12000 chars
